items.headline: Football's back — and the Hall of Fame Game ended on a dive at the buzzer
items.body: The NFL preseason opened in Canton with a wild one: undrafted QB Haynes King capped a 16-play final drive by scrambling and diving into the end zone with two seconds left, giving the Panthers a 33-30 win over the Cardinals. King threw for three scores in his first real taste of NFL action — a frantic, fun way to flip the calendar to football.
items.say: Football's officially back — the Hall of Fame Game ended on a quarterback diving into the end zone on the very last play. Panthers won 33-30. You ready for the season?

items.headline: One of the wildest finishes of the year — Chelsea Gray beats the Fever with two buzzer-beaters
items.body: The Aces trailed by 20, then Chelsea Gray wrote her name in the record book: she drilled a three at the regulation buzzer to force overtime, then another at the overtime buzzer to win it 86-84 — the first player in WNBA history to do both in the same game. A'ja Wilson had 26 points, 13 boards and the key stop on Caitlin Clark that set up the winner.
items.say: Did you see the Aces game? Chelsea Gray hit a buzzer-beater to force overtime, then another to win it — nobody's ever done both in one game. And they were down 20 to Caitlin Clark's Fever. Wild finish. You catch it?

links.text: ESPN · Gray's buzzer 3s lift Aces past Fever

items.headline: Barça are chasing a Ballon d'Or winner — Rodri gives the green light over a Man City exit
items.body: The summer's biggest midfield saga is heating up: Rodri, the 2024 Ballon d'Or winner, has told Barcelona he's open to a move and cleared them to negotiate with Manchester City — who'd reportedly let him go for around €60M with a year left on his deal. Barça have nudged ahead of Real Madrid in the race, and it'd be a genuine blockbuster if it lands.
items.say: Barcelona are trying to sign Rodri from Man City — the guy who won the Ballon d'Or. Word is he's given them the green light. That'd be a huge one. You follow the transfer stuff at all?

links.text: ESPN · Rodri gives Barcelona green light over Man City move

items.headline: San Diego's big night at the Azteca went sideways — Club América rolled them 3-1
items.body: Expansion darlings San Diego FC got the trip of a lifetime — a Leagues Cup match at Mexico City's iconic Azteca — but Liga MX leaders Club América spoiled the party, racing to an early lead and cruising to a 3-1 win in front of a roaring crowd. The MLS-vs-Liga MX border war keeps serving up drama every single night.
items.say: San Diego's new team got to play at the legendary Azteca this week — and América beat them 3-1. That Leagues Cup, the US teams against the Mexican teams, has been a lot of fun. You been catching any?

items.headline: Fight night's on Saturday — Gamrot and Salkilld headline in Vegas
items.body: If you want a Saturday scrap, the UFC's back at the Apex in Las Vegas: perennial top-10 lightweight Mateusz Gamrot faces rising Australian Quillan Salkilld in the main event, streaming on Paramount+. Gamrot's a relentless grappler on a roll — a gritty, high-pace matchup to throw on with the fights.
items.say: There's a UFC card Saturday night — Gamrot, this really tough Polish lightweight, headlining in Vegas. Good one to have on if you like the fights. You watch any MMA?

links.text: UFC.com · Main Event Preview — Gamrot vs. Salkilld

items.headline: Pop royalty, finally together — Madonna and Kylie drop their first-ever collab
items.body: After nearly 40 years of fans begging for it, Madonna and Kylie Minogue have teamed up on record for the first time: 'Love Sensation (Afterhours Mix),' produced by Stuart Price, arrived this week after they debuted it live at WorldPride in Amsterdam. Two dance-floor legends on one glittery track — a genuine event for pop fans.
items.say: Madonna and Kylie Minogue finally made a song together — their first one ever, after like 40 years. It's this big shimmery dance remix. Pop fans absolutely lost it. You into either of them?

links.text: Rolling Stone · Madonna & Kylie team up for 'Love Sensation'

items.headline: Ravyn Lenae's 'Blue Island' is here — the buzziest album of New Music Friday
items.body: Fresh off her breakout year, Chicago's Ravyn Lenae releases her third album 'Blue Island' today — her most adventurous yet, executive-produced by DJ Dahi and drifting between dreamy, nostalgic soul and pop. If you got hooked on 'Love Me Not' last year, this is the follow-up everyone's playing this weekend.
items.say: Ravyn Lenae dropped a new album today — she's that silky R&B singer who blew up with 'Love Me Not.' Really pretty stuff for a weekend playlist. You heard her yet?

links.text: The Line of Best Fit · 'Blue Island' review

items.headline: Before the fame — the young Anthony Bourdain biopic 'Tony' opens today
items.body: A24's 'Tony' hits New York and LA today (going wide Aug 21): 'Holdovers' breakout Dominic Sessa plays a 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain during the messy, formative Provincetown summer that pointed him toward kitchens and, eventually, stardom, with Antonio Banderas as an early mentor. Reviewers are calling it Sessa's first real movie-star turn.
items.say: There's an Anthony Bourdain movie out — 'Tony,' about him as a teenager before he got famous. The Holdovers kid plays him. Looks great if you loved Bourdain. You a fan of his stuff?

links.text: Variety · 'Tony' review — Dominic Sessa, Antonio Banderas

items.headline: Summer gets a scoop of dread — Eli Roth's 'Ice Cream Man' creeps into theaters
items.body: For the horror crowd, Eli Roth's 'Ice Cream Man' rolls into about 1,700 theaters this weekend: a sunny little town slides into madness when the neighborhood ice cream man starts serving up something a lot more sinister than sprinkles. Pure August creepshow fun if you like your summer with a scare.
items.say: There's a horror movie out this weekend called 'Ice Cream Man' — Eli Roth, the friendly neighborhood ice cream guy turns out to be a nightmare. Perfect dumb-fun scare. You into horror?
